title: potentilla ancistrifolia var. dickinsii
intro: Potentilla ancistrifolia var. dickinsii, commonly known as Five-Leaf Potentilla or Korean Five-Leaf Clover, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and various other health issues. The health benefits of Potentilla ancistrifolia var. dickinsii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial effects, which can help in soothing skin irritations and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
